# STARS - Showcase of Text, Archives, Research & Scholarship at UCF

> UCF's institutional repository providing open access to scholarly works, research data, theses, dissertations, and creative outputs across the university.

STARS is University of Central Florida's comprehensive digital repository built on the BePress Digital Commons platform. It serves as a central hub for discovering, sharing, and preserving UCF research, academic publications, and institutional scholarship while supporting open-access principles and research visibility.

## Key Topics

- institutional repository
- open access
- digital collections
- theses and dissertations
- research data
- scholarly publications
- UCF research
- peer-reviewed journals
- research units
- academic departments
- grant-funded research
- digital commons
- student research
- research showcase
- academic submissions

## Browse & Discover Collections

- [STARS Home](https://stars.library.ucf.edu): UCF's institutional repository for scholarly works, research, and creative outputs
- [Browse by Research Unit, Center, or Department](https://stars.library.ucf.edu/communities.html): Browse STARS collections by UCF research units, centers, and departments
- [UCF Theses and Dissertations](https://stars.library.ucf.edu/thesesdissertations): UCF graduate theses and dissertations collection in STARS repository
- [Research Data and Datasets](https://stars.library.ucf.edu/datasets): Research datasets and data sharing collection in STARS repository
- [Browse Journals and Peer-Reviewed Series](https://stars.library.ucf.edu/peer_review_list.html): Peer-reviewed journals and scholarly publications hosted in STARS
- [Browse Grant-Funded Projects](https://stars.library.ucf.edu/grant-funded.html): Grant-funded research projects and initiatives in STARS repository
- [Browse Events and Conferences](https://stars.library.ucf.edu/events_list.html): Browse UCF events, conferences, and proceedings in STARS
- [Podcasts](https://stars.library.ucf.edu/podcasts): UCF podcasts including history and cultural content from STARS

## About & Information

- [About Institutional Repositories](https://stars.library.ucf.edu/about.html): Information about STARS institutional repository and open-access mission
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://stars.library.ucf.edu/faq.html): FAQ covering submissions, copyright, and STARS repository usage
- [Most Popular Papers](https://stars.library.ucf.edu/topdownloads.html): Most downloaded and popular papers from STARS repository
- [Most Recent Additions](https://stars.library.ucf.edu/recent_additions.html): Recently added scholarship and research content to STARS

## Submit & Manage Content

- [Submit Your Research](https://stars.library.ucf.edu/submit_research.html): Guidelines for submitting research, theses, and data to STARS
- [Please Log In](https://stars.library.ucf.edu/cgi/myaccount.cgi): User authentication and account login for STARS contributors

## Stay Updated

- [Custom Email Notifications and RSS](https://stars.library.ucf.edu/announcements.html): Email alerts and RSS feeds for STARS content updates and notifications

## Optional

- [Activity by Year](https://stars.library.ucf.edu/activity.html): Repository statistics and annual activity metrics for STARS
- [Student Management of a University Cable TV Channel: A Case Study](https://stars.library.ucf.edu/aca/vol52/iss1/27): Peer-reviewed article on student-managed cable TV channel management
